Tap to open the Alarms and reminders settings for this app in Android; the app never grants access itself. You can revoke it at any time. Android cancels updates for this app when access is revoked, so a placed clock falls back to the live system text clock on its next update or resize. Updates are best-effort: deep idle or Doze can delay them.

1. Go to your home screen.
2. Long-press an empty area.
3. Tap Widgets.
4. Choose Dotwel Widgets.
5. Pick the widget you want.

No Alarms & reminders access is needed to place a widget.
Tap a category to preview its widgets and add the selected one. If your launcher shows no prompt, long-press the home screen and choose Widgets.

Dotwel Widgets is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Nothing Technology Limited, OnePlus, Kustom, or the referenced authors. This is a debug candidate, not Play-approved or runtime-verified.

Category previews use the same renderers as placed widgets. Dotted clocks and styled analog/world previews are bitmaps refreshed about once a minute when optional Alarms & reminders access is on; otherwise the live platform clock is shown. Battery readouts come from the system battery level. The Mini preset has no text layer, so Dotwel adds the real level in its own dot glyphs; no charge state is invented.

Only 4 of 40 presets are implemented; the remaining 36 stay pending or dependency-blocked and are not claimed as imported.

Original substitutions: Dotwel’s 5x7 circular-dot glyphs replace upstream fonts. Platform serif and sans-serif-condensed families replace NType, Lettera and Ndot. No upstream screenshots, logos, fonts, presets, APK, or OEM OnePlus code/assets are bundled.

The exact adapted-file mapping and the 40-preset ledger are retained in docs/ATTRIBUTION.md and docs/KWGT-LEDGER.md.

A live stacked-hours-and-minutes clock. The dotted bitmap updates about once a minute when Alarms & reminders access is enabled; deep idle can delay an update. Otherwise the system text clock is shown.
A live serif date with a red abbreviated weekday and black, translucent or transparent styling.
A bold circular analog clock using the upstream-derived palette, with a live platform analog clock fallback when minute updates are not available.
A slim analog clock with a full minute tick scale, with a live platform analog clock fallback when minute updates are not available.
Two configurable time zones. Uses the styled NtWorld bitmap when minute updates are enabled; otherwise shows live system TextClock rows for the chosen zones.
A daily quote from the AwesomeAWidgets author data file; tap to advance.
A circular battery gauge translated from the KWGT Nothing_Battery preset. The level comes from the system battery state; tap opens power settings where supported.
The KWGT Nothing_Battery_Mini concentric-ring gauge. The level comes from the system battery state; no text layer or added permission.

A four-line Nothing-style weekday, time, month and ordinal day from the KWGT Nothing_Date_Time preset. With Alarms & reminders access it draws the styled dot bitmap; otherwise it shows live platform text clocks.

A Nothing-style weekday and huge red day with lower-right hour and minute discs from the KWGT Nothing_Date_Time2 preset. With Alarms & reminders access it draws the styled minute bitmap; otherwise it shows live platform text clocks and no frozen analog discs.
Stacked hour and minute dots: upstream NtDigital fit and centre composition with Dotwel\u2019s original dot glyphs.
Day number and abbreviated red weekday using the translated NtDate fitting and baseline geometry.
NtAnalogBold provider wiring, redrawn as an original programmatic dial and bold hands because the upstream hand artwork is not bundled.
NtAnalogScale provider wiring with a sixty-tick scale, redrawn without the upstream dial/hand drawables.
NtWorld two-row world clock with per-widget zone choice before the native pin request.
NtQuotes layout with the upstream assets/nt_quotes.csv author data; tap cycles the daily offset.
KWGT Nothing_Battery layer geometry and level formula converted to a native provider: side/2 circle, level*3.6 arc and the author cm(215,g,b) colour, with Dotwel dot glyphs in place of ndot-47.ttf.
KWGT Nothing_Battery_Mini converted to a native provider: eleven concentric level rings using the author w/1.38\u2026w/1.005 sizes, primary arc and translucent track.

KWGT Nothing_Date_Time converted to a native provider: left-aligned weekday, red time, full month and ordinal day stack using the author side/8.5 offset, side/7 and side/6 text sizes and rounded square. Dotwel dot glyphs replace ndot-47.ttf.

KWGT Nothing_Date_Time2 converted to a native provider: upper-left weekday over a huge red day number and lower-right hour and minute discs with contrasting radial notches beside live hh and mm. Uses the author side/5 discs, smooth hour and minute rotations and serif platform fonts in place of NType82.

The styled KWGT date & time bitmap refreshes about once a minute and uses the same optional Alarms & reminders access. Without it, Add places a live date & time widget built from system text clocks. Dotwel never grants access for you.
